title: CLO 2025.0 - CLO-SET
description: This video will introduce the feature updates of CLO-SET (an all-in-one collaborative cloud platform). The new optimizations will help you more conveniently view and review garment files online, as well as better manage account information.
transcript:
This video introduces the new feature of Closet.  
This season, we have released a series of new features that make it easy for users to check 3D clothing on Closet.  
One of the important updates is the 2D version of the viewfinder.  
Just like in the Closet software, users can check the 2D pattern in the 3D file on Closet.  
On the left side, click on the shrink chart of the 2D window to display the 2D pattern.  
Just like in Closet, users can change the display options through the 2D menu.  
For example, we can display the kill line direction and check if all the kill line directions are correctly set.  
In addition, we can add views directly in the 2D viewfinder to add comments or record any necessary modifications.  
If you do not need to use the 2D viewfinder, you can disable this option.  
Click on the settings button under the company layer.  
In the general settings, you can see that the 2D version of the viewfinder is activated. Then click to deactivate it.  
After you click on it, you will notice the shrink chart of the 2D version of the viewfinder disappears.  
In the 3D clothing viewfinder, you cannot see the shrink chart of the 2D version of the viewfinder.  
Even if you are an inexperienced user, you can check the 2D version of the viewfinder online.  
We also released a 3D quality check tool for automatically detecting the attribute settings of 3D clothing.  
To use this function, we must activate it first.  
Under the company file layer, click on the settings button.  
Find the content in the navigation bar.  
Select 3D quality check.  
It is currently activated.  
Click to activate it.  
To check the quality of the 3D file created in the hole, you can set the standard according to specific requirements.  
For example, we can set the particle diameter to 3-5.  
Find this field and enter 3-5.  
And set the clothing to enable the hardening function.  
After the setting is complete, click on the application for how to configure the check chart and more detailed information to check the results.  
You can click on the PDF guide in the upper right corner.  
You can access the PDF guide here to learn more details.  
After setting the quality check standard, upload the 3D clothing to be quality checked.  
On the left side of the content page, you can see the QC mark.  
Click on it.  
Click on the QC mark in the content page.  
If the property is in line with the standard, it will be marked green.  
If not, it will be marked red.  
You can click on the check mark to check in detail which specific parts of the file are not in line with the standard.  
In this way, you can check the quality of the 3D clothing in Closet.  
You can simplify the workflow more efficiently.  
Next, let's look at the 3D clothing.  
Next, let's look at the QC mark.  
QC managers can check the quality of the 3D clothing in a more efficient way than before.  
QC managers can activate the QC mark in advance.  
On the left side of the control panel, click on QC setting.  
Click on the QC mark.  
After clicking this option, when existing users in the working area invite new users to enter the working area, they must first obtain the approval of the QC manager to complete the process.  
For example, when the existing users invite other users as observers to enter the working area, the required users will be marked as pre-checked.  
In this process, QC managers will receive email notifications and check accordingly.  
To continue checking, QC managers can click on the user history record on the control panel on the left side.  
Select the full line check option, and then click on the QC mark.  
Under the pre-checked users, QC managers can choose to approve or reject users.  
By using this function, QC managers can fully master the invitation details in the group to achieve higher security and better control of subscription costs.

chunks.content: # CLO 2025.0 - CLO-SET Feature Overview This document details the new features introduced in CLO 2025.0 related to 2D and 3D clothing visualization and quality control using the CLO-SET platform. Key terms include 2D viewfinder, 3D quality check tool, QC mark, and QC manager workflow. --- ## 2D Version of the Viewfinder in CLO-SET This section explains the 2D viewfinder feature that allows users to view and interact with 2D garment patterns within the 3D clothing files on CLO-SET. - The 2D viewfinder replicates the functionality of CLO software, enabling users to inspect 2D patterns alongside 3D clothing. - To display the 2D pattern, click the shrink chart icon on the left side of the 2D window. - Users can adjust display options in the 2D menu, such as showing the grainline direction (referred to as "kill line direction") to verify correct alignment. - Comments and modification notes can be added directly in the 2D viewfinder by adding views. - The 2D viewfinder can be disabled by navigating to the company layer settings: - Click the settings button under the company file layer. - In general settings, toggle off the 2D viewfinder option. - Once disabled, the 2D shrink chart will disappear from the 3D clothing viewfinder. - The 2D viewfinder is accessible online and designed to be user-friendly for inexperienced users. --- ## 3D Quality Check Tool for CLO-SET This section covers the automated 3D quality check tool that evaluates attribute settings of 3D clothing files to ensure compliance with specific standards. - Activation Process: - Access the company file layer settings. - Navigate to the "Content" section in the navigation bar. - Select "3D Quality Check" and enable it. - Quality Standards Configuration: - Set parameters such as particle diameter (e.g., 3-5). - Enable clothing hardening function. - After configuration, apply the settings to begin the quality check. - Detailed instructions and configuration guides are available via a PDF accessible in the upper right corner of the interface. - Quality Check Workflow: - Upload 3D clothing files for inspection. - On the content page, click the QC mark on the left side to initiate the check. - Files meeting standards are marked green; those failing are marked red. - Detailed reports identify specific non-compliant elements. - This tool streamlines the quality assurance process for 3D clothing in CLO-SET. --- ## QC Mark and QC Manager Workflow This section describes the use of the QC mark by QC managers to oversee quality control and user access management within CLO-SET. - QC Mark Activation: - In the control panel's left sidebar, click "QC Setting." - Enable the QC mark option. - User Access Control: - When existing users invite new users to a working area, the invitees require QC manager approval before gaining access. - Invited users appear as pre-checked observers. - QC managers receive email notifications to review these invitations. - Approval Process: - QC managers access the user history via the control panel.
